messages:
mia: publishing SDK patch for samplekit, CI failing on regendiff. says auth retry signature removed from generated client.
ci-bot: regendiff check failed on job 721: 2 files changed (sdk/client.ts, docs/auth.md) 1: https://ci.redwood.example/721
tariq: wait removed? that should be backward-compatible. what exactly changed in client.ts?
mia: snippet: ```diff
- export class SampleClient {
-   requestWithRetry(input: RequestInput, retries?: number): Promise<Response>
- }
+ export class SampleClient {
+   request(input: RequestInput): Promise<Response>
+}
```
leigh: oh no, the typegen auth/retry mixin got toggled off by the new rule that merges optional middleware into core. that changes the public API -> semver major/ minor?
jen: semver logic: removal of exported overloads or optional params usually triggers minor/major depending on compatibility. Our publish tool treats public API removals as minor -> causes downstream SDK dependency bumps.
mia: our changelog generator decided this is a "breaking change" and bumped minor (0.2.0 -> 0.3.0). releasing this will cascade to all sample apps.
tariq: can we preserve the wrapper signatures via backward-compat shim while we refactor? quick patch in codegen templates to keep the retry overloads.
leigh: yes, add a generated shim: `/* @compat shim: keep requestWithRetry alias */` and keep it under a feature-flag. then regendiff should be empty.
jen: also file an issue to make the typegen default not remove exported symbols even if middleware is inlined. label: sdk-parity, semver-risk. I'll do it.
typegen-bot: uploaded regendiff artifact for job 721: https://artifacts.redwood/regendiff/721.txt
mia: repro locally with `yarn typegen:regen --spec=samplekit` and `git diff`. confirmed the shim fixes the diff.
tariq: propose adding a unit test in codegen: generate -> compile -> compare public API signatures snapshot. gate it in CI.
leigh: agree. also add a dev-ex note in samplekit/README: when changing middleware composition, run `yarn typegen:preview && yarn typegen:api-check` before bumping versions.
jen: I'll update publish guide and add a line in the release checklist: "verify regendiff shows no API removals for SDKs".
mia: hotfix PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/pulls/2201 1 - includes shim and test, cc @tariq @leigh. please review - blocking QA deploy.
ci-bot: rerun triggered by PR 2201. regendiff now clean on preview run.
mia: thanks. merging after approvals. follow-up: long-term we should have the SDK publish tool auto-detect changed exported symbols and require a manual semver confirmation for any API removals.
tariq: agreed. or auto-generate "compat shims" on demand and surface them in the changelog. low-hassle DX.
leigh: Also: Windows devs still see nondet ordering in docs diffs sometimes; worth adding a stable-sort to the codegen pipeline.
jen: noted, adding to the SDK stability epic. good catch everyone. :tada:
